title: Cerebra Agent UI Specification
description: Universal UI specification format for agent-to-UI communication using GD Design Library. Auto-generated from libs/ui/src/ai/a2ui/spec-schema.ts — do not edit manually.

version.description: Semantic version of the UI specification

provider.description: LLM provider or orchestration source for the generated spec, for example openai, anthropic, gemini, or local

scenario.description: Scenario, use case, or workflow identifier associated with this spec

segment.description: Optional orchestration segment or stage identifier when a flow is generated in multiple parts

isSimulated.description: Demo-only flag indicating the spec was simulated or replayed instead of generated live

components.description: Array of UI components to render.

actions.description: Available actions referenced by component actions[] arrays.

validations.description: Form validation rules associated with components.

state.description: Current UI state for state management

type.description: Layout type mapping to GD Design Library layout components

spacing.description: Spacing between elements — must be a real CSS value (e.g. '16px', '1rem'). Never use token strings like 'xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl', 'none'.

gridColumns.description: Number of columns for grid layout

Styling.description: CSS styling for the component. All values MUST be real CSS values (e.g. '16px', '1rem', '50%'). NEVER use design token strings like 'xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl', 'none'.

flex.description: CSS flex shorthand for the component itself inside a flex container (e.g. '1', '0 0 auto', '1 1 50%')

type.description: Component type — maps to gd-design-library (GridKit) React component. Source of truth: ./component-map.ts

initial.description: Initial numeric value used by counter components.

caption.description: Optional caption text for images. Only used by type "image".

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label used when visible text alone is not sufficient.

content.description: Tooltip text content. Only used by type "tooltip".

name.description: Component-specific name. For avatar-user: user display name. For loader: animation type ("circle" or "dots"). For rating: radio group name. Prefer dedicated props where documented.

subtitle.description: Secondary text line. Only used by type "avatar-user".

className.description: Optional CSS class name forwarded to wrapper-style primitives such as box and wrapper.

tabIndex.description: Keyboard tab order for focusable primitives such as box.

layout.description: Carousel layout direction. Only used by type "carousel".

htmlFor.description: Associated form control ID for label components. Only used by type "label".

captionAs.description: HTML tag override for image captions. Only used by type "image".

WrapperView.description: Underlying HTML tag for the optional portal wrapper. Only used by type "portal".

container.description: CSS selector for an existing DOM node that should receive portal content. Only used by type "portal".

href.description: Link destination URL. Top-level field for type "link".

target.description: Link browsing context. Top-level field for type "link".

rel.description: Link relationship attribute. Top-level field for type "link".

buttonType.description: HTML button type attribute. Only used by type "button".

placement.description: Component placement. Used by tooltip ("top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right"), menu corner placement, and snackbar overlay placement.

length.description: Separator explicit length (for example "40px" or "100%"). Especially useful for vertical separators. Only used by type "separator".

isOpen.description: Controlled open state for collapsible layout components such as chat-container.

bordered.description: Whether the component renders with a bordered container. Used by type "breadcrumbs".

checked.description: Checked/on state for checkbox and switch components.

allowMultipleExpand.description: Whether accordion allows multiple items to stay expanded at once.

withoutSeparator.description: Whether accordion items render without divider lines.

isInline.description: Whether accordion headers render using inline layout.

defaultValue.description: Initial uncontrolled value. Used by accordion, radio-group, and rating components. Type depends on the component.

max.description: Maximum numeric value. Used by counter as the upper bound, by rating as the total item count, and by slider when modeled as a top-level prop.

min.description: Minimum numeric value. Used by counter as the lower bound and by slider when modeled as a top-level prop.

variant.description: Visual variant for the component. Button: primary|secondary|tertiary|outlined|text|inherit. Separator: solid|dashed|dotted. Card: vertical|horizontal. Badge: primary|secondary|tertiary|quaternary|quinary. Inline-notification: success|warning|error|info.

appearance.description: Secondary visual appearance modifier. For badge: filled|filledLight|outline|outlineFilledLight.

size.description: Size token. For icon: resolves to fixed px dimensions (xs=14px, sm=16px, md=18px, lg=24px, xl=32px, xxl=40px). For other components: semantic size (xs–xxl).

styleVariant.description: Typography style modifiers. Use a string or array such as "bold" or ["italic", "underline"]. Only used by type "typography".

underline.description: Link underline behavior. Top-level field for type "link".

labelSide.description: Switch label placement relative to the control. Only used by type "switch".

separator.description: Breadcrumb text separator (for example "/" or ">"). Also used by type "attachment-file" as the character between fileType and fileSize (defaults to "·").

separatorIcon.description: Icon name used as the breadcrumb separator. Only used by type "breadcrumbs".

separatorAfterLastItem.description: Whether breadcrumbs should render a separator after the last item.

rounded.description: Loader border radius for dots animation. Top-level field for type "loader".

withWrapper.description: Whether a helper wrapper container should be rendered. Used by type "loader" and "portal".

wrapperVariant.description: Wrapper preset used by the portal helper wrapper. Only used by type "portal".

blocksScroll.description: Whether the portal should lock background document scrolling while mounted.

animationName.description: Skeleton animation keyframe name. Accepts theme animation token names such as "blinkKeyframes", raw CSS animation names, or null to disable the built-in animation. Only used by type "skeleton".

animationProps.description: Custom CSS animation shorthand forwarded to skeleton or loader when fine-grained animation control is needed.

color.description: Top-level color prop. Prefer theme color token paths (e.g. "text.secondary", "border.default"). Palette-style aliases like "brand.500" and "theme.palette.warning.main" are also accepted. Use raw CSS/hex only when no theme token fits. Used by typography and separator.

icon.description: Icon name from GD icon set. Used by the icon component, snackbar, accordion header expand icons, and avatar icon fallbacks. Also accepted as a legacy alias for iconStart on some leading-adornment components.

iconStart.description: Leading icon name from GD icon set. Preferred field for components with a start icon or adornment such as badge, button, input, input-file, menu triggers, and select.

iconEnd.description: Trailing icon name from GD icon set. Used by button, badge, input, input-file, and select.

fill.description: Fill color for multi-path icons. Prefer theme color token paths (e.g. "icon.error", "icon.primary", "icon.default"). Use raw CSS/hex only when no theme token fits. Used by type "icon" and avatar icon fallbacks.

fillSvg.description: Uniform fill color for the entire SVG. Prefer theme color token paths (same options as fill). Use raw CSS/hex only when no theme token fits. Overrides fill. Used by type "icon" and avatar icon fallbacks.

width.description: Width. For icon: pixel number (e.g. 24). For layout components: CSS string (e.g. "100%", "200px").

height.description: Height. For icon: pixel number (e.g. 24). For layout components: CSS string (e.g. "100px").

minHeight.description: Minimum height constraint. Use CSS strings for layout components (for example "120px") or numbers for menu positioning logic.

count.description: SliderDots total dot count. Only used by type "slider-dots".

activeIndex.description: Active index or active option value. Used by slider-dots and select components.

step.description: Slider step increment. Only used by type "slider".

lines.description: Maximum number of lines before truncation. Only used by type "truncate".

objectFit.description: Image object-fit behavior. Only used by type "image".

fullWidth.description: Whether the internal button should stretch to the full container width. Used by button/input-file.

isIcon.description: Whether the control should render as an icon-only button. Used by button/input-file.

showArrows.description: Whether carousel navigation arrows are visible. Used by type "carousel" and "content-carousel".

showDots.description: Whether carousel dot indicators are visible. Used by type "carousel" and "content-carousel".

thumbs.description: Thumbnail strip position. Only used by type "carousel".

isFocusable.description: Whether the carousel root receives keyboard focus. Used by type "carousel" and "content-carousel".

visibleItems.description: Number of items visible at once. Only used by type "content-carousel".

scrollStep.description: Number of items to scroll per navigation action. Only used by type "content-carousel".

scrollAlignment.description: Content carousel scroll alignment. Only used by type "content-carousel".

vertical.description: Vertical scrollbar visibility. Only used by type "scroll".

horizontal.description: Horizontal scrollbar visibility. Only used by type "scroll".

autoHide.description: Whether visible scrollbars should fade out after scrolling stops. Only used by type "scroll".

showSidebarAsideControl.description: Whether the chat sidebar shows its internal collapse/close control.

showSidebarHeaderControl.description: Whether the main chat header shows the control that reopens the sidebar.

multiple.description: Multi-value selection mode for select/input-file components.

searchable.description: Whether the select shows a search field.

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the select search field.

autoOpen.description: Whether the select dropdown opens automatically on render.

accept.description: Accepted file MIME types or extensions for input-file.

inputFileButtonLabel.description: Visible label for the drag-and-drop file picker button.

acceptedFileTypes.description: Allowed MIME types for drag-and-drop file validation.

maxFileSize.description: Maximum allowed file size in bytes for each dropped or selected file.

maxFiles.description: Maximum total number of files allowed by drag-and-drop.

debounceCallbackTime.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds for input change handlers.

ariaDescribedBy.description: ID of helper/error text announced by screen readers.

resize.description: Textarea resize mode. Only used by type "textarea".

dynamicHeightAdjustment.description: Whether textarea height should auto-grow with content.

maxCharacters.description: Maximum character count for textarea. Shows a counter in the UI.

currentValue.description: Current formatted price value without the currency symbol. Only used by type "price".

oldValue.description: Optional previous price shown as the struck-through comparison value. Only used by type "price".

currencySymbol.description: Currency symbol displayed by price components (for example "$", "€", or "zł").

currencySymbolPosition.description: Where the currency symbol should appear relative to the value. Only used by type "price".

gutter.description: Gap between direct children for row, column, and card container components.

gap.description: Top-level gap prop used by flex-container and as an alias for row/column gutter.

padding.description: CSS inner padding for card and related layout containers.

align.description: Cross-axis alignment for row and column layout primitives.

justify.description: Main-axis distribution for row and column layout primitives.

isWrap.description: Whether row or column children are allowed to wrap.

flex.description: CSS flex shorthand for row or column components when they are children of another flex container.

isReversed.description: Whether row or column direction is visually reversed.

flexDirection.description: Top-level flex direction prop for flex-container.

alignItems.description: Top-level align-items prop for flex-container or alias for row/column alignment.

justifyContent.description: Top-level justify-content prop for flex-container or alias for row/column justification.

showPercentage.description: Whether the progress bar should show a numeric percentage label.

fillColor.description: Filled-track color for progress bars. Prefer theme token paths before raw CSS or hex colors.

closeOnSelect.description: Whether a menu closes immediately after an option is selected.

offsetX.description: Horizontal offset in pixels used by menu positioning.

offsetY.description: Vertical offset in pixels used by menu positioning.

gridColumns.description: Radio-group grid column count when variant is "grid".

gridRows.description: Radio-group grid row count when variant is "grid".

gridColumnGutter.description: Horizontal spacing between radio-group grid items.

gridRowGutter.description: Vertical spacing between radio-group grid rows.

wrapItems.description: Whether radio-group items should wrap in row or column layouts.

itemWidth.description: Per-option width for radio-group visual tiles.

itemHeight.description: Per-option height for radio-group visual tiles.

isIconsView.description: Whether stepper indicators should render icons instead of step numbers.

duration.description: Auto-dismiss duration in milliseconds. Only used by type "snackbar".

dismissOnClick.description: Whether clicking the snackbar should dismiss it.

colored.description: Whether the snackbar uses a filled background matching its variant.

isAnimated.description: Whether the snackbar should animate in and out.

stickyHeader.description: Whether the table header should remain visible while scrolling.

stickyFooter.description: Whether the table footer should remain visible while scrolling.

stickyPagination.description: Whether the table pagination row should remain visible while scrolling.

pagination.description: Whether the table should render built-in pagination controls.

pageSize.description: Initial number of rows per page when table pagination is enabled.

pageSizes.description: Selectable page-size options for table pagination.

virtualized.description: Whether the table should use virtualization for large row sets.

rowHeight.description: Row height in pixels for virtualized tables.

minVisibleRange.description: Minimum buffered visible range for virtualized tables.

options.description: Options for select, radio, checkbox groups

rows.description: Data rows for table or list component

data.description: Alias for rows — accepted when LLM generates data instead of rows

errors.description: Inline validation or upload error messages, used by drag-and-drop.

files.description: Current file metadata for drag-and-drop controlled state.

children.description: Nested child components (not recursively validated to avoid cascading errors)

dragOverContent.description: Custom nested components shown while drag-and-drop is in its active hover state.

loadingOverlay.description: Custom nested components shown while drag-and-drop isLoading is true.

dragOverChildren.description: A2UI child components shown while drag-and-drop is in its hover state.

footer.description: Footer components rendered in the modal footer bar (e.g. action buttons). Only used by type "modal".

actionChildren.description: Nested child components rendered in a dedicated action area such as chat-bubble actions or header utilities.

logoChildren.description: Header logo slot content. Only used by type "header".

menuChildren.description: Header primary navigation slot content. Only used by type "header".

bannerChildren.description: Header top banner content. Only used by type "header".

advChildren.description: Header promo/supporting content shown below the mobile menu. Only used by type "header".

headerChildren.description: Sidebar header slot content. Only used by type "sidebar".

footerChildren.description: Sidebar footer slot content. Only used by type "sidebar".

headerContent.description: Named slot content for the main chat header. Only used by type "chat-container".

sidebarContent.description: Named slot content for the expanded chat sidebar. Only used by type "chat-container".

sidebarMinifiedContent.description: Named slot content for the collapsed chat sidebar rail. Only used by type "chat-container".

sidebarHeaderContent.description: Named slot content above the expanded chat sidebar. Only used by type "chat-container".

items.description: Component-specific items collection. Used by sidebar for nested navigation items and by search-modal grouped sections.

images.description: ImagePreview image items with src, optional alt text, and optional caption.

results.description: SearchModal result items or grouped sections displayed for an active query.

historyResults.description: SearchModal recent or grouped history items displayed before a query is typed.

popularItems.description: Optional SearchModal section object with title and items[].

aiSuggestions.description: Optional SearchModal AI suggestions section object with title and items[].

articles.description: Optional SearchModal articles section object with title and items[].

sizeVariant.description: Avatar size variant — alias for "size" on avatar components.

orientation.description: Separator direction. Only used by type "separator".

labelPosition.description: Separator label position. Only used by type "separator".

backgroundColor.description: Avatar background color for initials fallback, or skeleton fill color. Prefer theme color token paths (e.g. "bg.fill.secondary", "bg.fill.success.primary.default") or palette-style aliases like "brand.500" and "theme.palette.success.main". Use raw CSS/hex only when no theme token fits.

badgeColor.description: Avatar badge dot color. Prefer theme color token paths (e.g. "bg.fill.success.primary.default"). Use raw CSS/hex only when no theme token fits. Only when withBadge is true.

labelColor.description: Separator label text color. Prefer theme color token paths (e.g. "text.caption", "text.warning"). Palette-style aliases like "brand.500" and "theme.palette.warning.main" are also accepted. Use raw CSS/hex only when no theme token fits. Only used by type "separator".

showCloseButton.description: Whether to show the × close button in the modal header. Only used by type "modal". Defaults to true.

closeOnEscape.description: Whether pressing Escape closes the modal. Only used by type "modal".

closeOnClickOutside.description: Whether clicking the backdrop closes the modal. Only used by type "modal".

isCustomView.description: Whether the modal uses a fully custom layout without the default header/footer chrome. Only used by type "modal".

title.description: Component-specific title text. Used by chart for accessible titles and by modal as an alternate heading field.

description.description: Component-specific descriptive text, for example chart descriptions or drag-and-drop helper text.

status.description: Chat bubble generation status. Only used by type "chat-bubble".

bgColor.description: Header background color override. Prefer theme color token paths (for example "bg.surface") before raw CSS/hex colors.

mobileMenuList.description: Header mobile drawer menu items. Only used by type "header".

emptyItemsResult.description: Search empty-state message shown when no options match the current value.

carouselOptions.description: Embla carousel options such as loop or align. Only used by type "carousel".

chartHeight.description: Height of the chart canvas in pixels. Only used by type "chart".

xKey.description: Data key used for the chart x-axis. Only used by type "chart".

series.description: Chart series definitions for line, bar, and area charts.

tooltip.description: Chart tooltip configuration using JSON-safe fields only.

loading.description: Whether the chart is in a loading state.

error.description: Whether the chart is in an error state.

searchValue.description: Current search query. Used by type "search-modal".

noHistoryResultsLabel.description: SearchModal empty-state label shown before a query is typed.

noResultsLabel.description: SearchModal empty-state label shown when a query returns no results.

newSearchCta.description: SearchModal CTA label for starting a new search or chat.

loaderItemsCount.description: Number of skeleton rows shown by SearchModal while loading.

showSearch.description: Whether header renders its built-in search affordance.

showTopBanner.description: Whether header renders its top banner area.

showCharacterCount.description: Whether InputArea shows a live character counter.

showAttachmentButton.description: Whether InputArea shows its attachment button.

showSendButton.description: Whether InputArea shows its send button.

showSendButtonTooltip.description: Whether to show a tooltip on hover of the InputArea send button.

sendButtonLabel.description: Accessible label for the InputArea send button.

attachmentButtonLabel.description: Tooltip and accessible label for the InputArea attachment button.

recordingState.description: Voice recording state for InputArea. "idle" shows normal input, "recording" shows cancel/confirm controls, "processing" disables confirm and shows a spinner.

recordButtonLabel.description: Accessible label for the InputArea record button.

minRows.description: Minimum visible textarea rows for InputArea.

maxRows.description: Maximum visible textarea rows for InputArea before scrolling.

showThumbnails.description: Whether ImagePreview shows its thumbnail strip.

showCounter.description: Whether ImagePreview shows the current/total counter.

collapsed.description: Whether sidebar renders in collapsed mode.

fileName.description: Name of the attached file displayed in the AttachmentFile chip. Truncates with a tooltip on hover when long.

fileType.description: File type label shown below the file name in AttachmentFile (e.g. "PDF", "doc"). Truncates with ellipsis when long.

fileSize.description: File size label shown below the file name in AttachmentFile (e.g. "1.2 MB").

removeButtonLabel.description: Accessible aria-label for the AttachmentFile remove button.

isLoading.description: Shows a spinner in place of the remove button while uploading. Only takes effect when actions[] is also provided.

actions.description: Action IDs from ui.actions to trigger when the remove button is clicked. The remove button is only rendered when this array is non-empty. Maps to onRemove in TSX.

validation.description: Optional validation rule IDs associated with this component.

type.description: Custom action type string matching an A2UIActionDefinition type (e.g. "add-to-cart", "action-view-all").

endpoint.description: API endpoint for api-call or agent-call types.

action.description: ID of action to execute on success.

redirect.description: URL to redirect to on success.

action.description: ID of action to execute on error.

loading.description: Show loading state during action execution.

componentId.description: ID of the component to validate.
